newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala to begin oil, natgas exploration bidding.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala to begin oil, natgas exploration bidding.

text.p: Guatemala's Energy and Mines Ministry will initiate an international bidding process for oil and natural gas exploration and exploitation in 12 areas in the next four months, an official said Wednesday.
"In the call for bids on petroleum areas we have 12 areas for 1997," Francisco Arevalo, director of hydrocarbons for the ministry, told Reuters in an interview.
The Ministry will accept bids on two areas from March 11-14 and bids on the other 10 areas May 13-16. Arevalo said the government hopes to announce the results by mid-June.
